title: Linear-time computation of the canonical count
statement: For every machine format $F$, there exist a finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet and a natural number $a$ such that, on every Boolean input word $w$, $M$ computes the canonical count of $w$ within $a(|w|+1)$ steps.
